race.description: Cetnaj Tamworth Big Dance Day 3rd November (Bm50) Hcp
race.comment: RISK ASSESSMENT (9) has been close up at non-tab meetings at his last couple of runs, most recently 12 days ago when beaten under a length over 1720m at Barraba. Rarely far away and in an even contest he looks a good chance to return to the winner's list. Veteran JUST ONE LOOK (2) wound back the clock last start with an effortless victory over 1250m at Kempsey. Draws the fence and always goes well at Tamworth so another big run looks on the cards. GOLD SMILES (1) stormed home late to be beaten under a length over this distance at Dubbo recently. Capable of featuring in the finish in what looks an easier race. The evergreen RIVALDO (3) has strung together seven top-three finishes including a last start third in a BM66 here at this trip. Solid contender. SIDENAY (4) is racing well without winning. The stat that jumps off the page is three runs at Tamworth for three wins - must be considered on the strength of that alone.
